definition.simple: How much and how fast a price moves up and down.
definition.balanced: High volatility means bigger swings, in both directions. It often rises around news. Wider swings need wider stops for the same idea, which means a smaller size for the same money at risk. [[slippage|Slippage]] and wider spreads are more common when volatility is high.

example: A pair that usually moves 50 pips a day moves 150 pips on a news day.
